page_title: VAL 0-3 ATM | Valencia v Atletico Madrid 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+2' Giorgi Mamardashvili displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Valencia are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.

86' 0 - 3 Stunning strike! Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) latches on to a precise through ball from Conor Gallagher before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 0:3.
86' Fran Perez (Valencia) works the corner short.
85' Fran Perez (Valencia) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Valencia.

84' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Atl. Madrid are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
81' Andre Almeida (Valencia) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Enzo Barrenechea will be replaced by Diego Lopez (Valencia).
80' Valencia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

80' Rafa Mir (Valencia) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Jan Oblak displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The ball is out of play. Valencia win a corner kick.
78' Andre Almeida (Valencia) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
77' Jose Gaya (Valencia) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Valencia get a corner.

76' A cross by Fran Perez (Valencia) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
74' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Julian Alvarez and he is replaced by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
74' Here is a change. Umar Sadiq is going off and Carlos Corberan gives the last tactical orders to Rafa Mir (Valencia).
73' The substitution is prepared. Fran Perez (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Luis Rioja.

73' Andre Almeida (Valencia) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
71' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
70' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for an infringement.
68' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) replacing Giuliano Simeone.
68' The substitution has been made. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) has replaced Antoine Griezmann.
67' A corner kick by Valencia is thwarted by the well prepared Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid).
67' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
65' Here comes a substitution. Andre Almeida (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Ivan Jaime.

65' The cross into the penalty area from Hugo Duro (Valencia) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
64' What was Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

62' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball is behind the touchline and Valencia will take a throw-in.

60' Atl. Madrid slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
58' Ivan Jaime (Valencia) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
57' Valencia showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
56' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him.
54' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
52' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes low to the middle of the target, but Jan Oblak keeps it out.
52' A short through ball almost allows Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
50' Javi Guerra (Valencia) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post.
49' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
48' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
46' Diego Simeone makes a half-time substitution. Javi Galan comes on in place of Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) comes off for Conor Gallagher.
46' Half-time substitution. Pepelu (Valencia) will not participate anymore and Hugo Duro is coming on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Luis Rioja (Valencia), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall.

45+3' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Mateo Busquets stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Valencia are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

45+1' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia. A brilliant individual effort! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Javi Guerra (Valencia) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
42' Javi Guerra (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
42' Wonderful movement by Atl. Madrid. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
40' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

37' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) launches himself at the ball from the free kick and produces a header which lacks accuracy, sending it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
36' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul after Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) hacks down one of his opponents. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Valencia.
35' Atl. Madrid are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
32' A cross from Luis Rioja (Valencia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
31' Wonderful movement by Valencia. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

30' 0 - 2 Antoine Griezmann showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 0:2.
27' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
26' Pepelu (Valencia) was too forceful with his tackle and Mateo Busquets interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Atl. Madrid earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
23' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is awarded a yellow card.

23' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.

22' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Atl. Madrid.
19' Valencia restart play with a quick free kick.
19' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle. Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play. Valencia are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
17' A pass from Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by Giorgi Mamardashvili and the move breaks down.
14' Valencia seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
12' 0 - 1 Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb into the top right corner. What a perfect shot.

12' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Atl. Madrid are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
9' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
8' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
8' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Umar Sadiq (Valencia), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. Valencia have a corner.
6' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
5' Ivan Jaime (Valencia) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
5' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mateo Busquets blows for a foul. A free kick to Valencia.
4' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.

3' Atl. Madrid slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
